svg.title: Native Execution Engine fallback: the four trigger tiers
svg.desc: A diagnostic taxonomy diagram detailing the four fallback tiers of the Native Execution Engine (NEE) in Microsoft Fabric, from whole-query disqualifiers to data type limits, and the three verification surfaces.
svg.text: Native Execution Engine (NEE): Four Fallback Trigger Tiers
Blast Radius Taxonomy · C++ Velox Disqualifiers · Spark Advisor Alerts · Diagnostics & Physical Plan Verification
FALLBACK TAXONOMY: FROM QUERY-LEVEL DISQUALIFIERS TO TYPE BARRIERS

g.title: Tier 1 — whole query falls back — Streaming, ANSI mode and JSON/XML sources force the entire query onto the JVM.
g.text: • Zero operators run on C++ Velox

g.title: Tier 2 — one operator falls back — An operator with no Velox equivalent runs on the JVM with conversions either side.
g.text: to the very end of plan

g.aria-label: Tier 3 — one expression, whole operator lost
g.title: Tier 3 — one expression, whole operator lost — One unsupported expression or UDF drops its whole enclosing operator to the JVM.
g.text: • ONE single Python UDF inside a

g.title: Tier 4 — data types — Deeply nested and complex data types push execution back to the JVM.
Read the plan — Plan suffixes reveal which operators genuinely executed natively.
g.text: Verify native operator signatures in physical plan
Look for `*Transformer` suffixes in query plan:
Always inspect the FINAL adaptive plan (after AQE execution)

g.title: Spark Advisor, inline — The Spark Advisor alerts on fallback in real time as a notebook cell runs.
g.text: Real-time notebook cell warnings during development
Immediate developer feedback inside Fabric notebook UI:
• Alerts appear directly above cell output in seconds
• Names the exact function or operator causing fallback
• Provides clickable guidance to native replacement syntax
Shortens dev feedback loop from hours to seconds.
Fix code interactively before committing to Git.
Use Spark Advisor during prototype authoring to eliminate
all Tier 2 and Tier 3 fallback triggers before production release.

g.title: Diagnostics pane, post-run — The Diagnostics pane names the root cause of fallback after the run.
g.text: Post-run root cause telemetry for scheduled batch jobs
Application-wide fallback analytics in Monitoring Hub:
• % of operators executed natively vs on JVM
• Root-cause ranking for scheduled Spark Job Definitions
• Identifies time spent in Row-to-Columnar transitions
Generates tuning backlog for platform engineers.
Target >90% native operator execution on conformed Gold
analytics workloads to minimize Fabric capacity unit billing.

svg.text: Fabric Codex — Original Infographic, August 2026. Grounded in Microsoft Fabric Native Execution Engine Specs.
